title: Choose the visual world for /jobs
question: Fresh hand. The roll assigned Scantron Floor. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. /jobs stays scan-and-act: apply, mark applied, hide, save.

options.label: Scantron Floor
options.lineage: classroom scantron sheets and exam seating charts
options.thesis: Each internship is a numbered exam item. You fill one bubble: Apply, Applied, Can't fit, Save.
options.viewport: No hero. A full-bleed exam sheet: left timing track as nav, numbered CLOCK/TEAM/PLAY stems, four full-height bubbles on every row.
options.risk: Reads as a joke test if the sheet is sparse instead of a dense market of items.

raised.raise: Four Marks: the only color on the sheet is the four action bubbles, used nowhere else.
Chase Pip: a running mark always sits on the newest listing, like the step that is now.
One Pull: filling a bubble is the only transform; no hover chrome does the work.
Named Bands: recency is Today / This week / Older, never color alone.

options.label: Wire Copy
options.thesis: The market arrives as copy: timestamped slugs you file, spike, or send.
options.viewport: A continuous wire: time, desk, slug. Apply is SEND, Mark applied is FILED, Can't fit is SPIKE, Save is HOLD.
options.risk: Also a familiar live-feed landing: incoming data dressed as a newsroom.

options.label: Creator Bench
options.thesis: Roles sit on bone keycaps in a gunmetal grid; the one safety-orange key is Apply.
options.viewport: A keycap grid of internships, families by row, a knurled knob for filters, one orange APPLY key, amber screen showing the live count.
options.case: Holds product clarity: commit is one obvious orange key. Loses audience identification: intern hunters are not at a stream-deck bench.
options.risk: Titles truncated onto keycaps hide the market you came to read.

options.label: Glyph Grid
options.thesis: The catalog is a phosphor grid: internships as selectable lines of text, density standing in for rank.
options.viewport: One character grid. RoleRadar as a header line, listings as rows of monospace copy, APPLY/FILE/SPIKE/HOLD as commands in the same grid.
options.case: Holds audience identification: SWE intern hunters already live in terminals. Loses product clarity: glyph sculpture is not a scannable market of titles and locations.
options.risk: Reads as a demo-scene toy when the grid is decorative instead of the actual list.

options.label: Monochrome Proof
options.case: Loses both: claim-and-proof marketing is not a scan-and-act market, and identification is generic SaaS.
options.kept: Four Marks: a single accent used only on the four actions.

options.label: Step Row
options.case: Loses both: sixteen steps cannot hold a live market, and intern hunters are not writing drum patterns.
options.kept: Chase Pip: a running mark that always says which listing is now.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.case: Loses both: cloth transformation cannot carry listing facts or scan-and-act.
options.kept: One Pull: filling a bubble is the only transform.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.case: Loses both: atmosphere bands are not a job market, and color-as-time fights Operate scan.
options.kept: Named Bands: recency as Today / This week / Older, never color alone.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Handshake / Simplify / LinkedIn intern board executed at full craft: sidebar, filters, card rows, primary Apply.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav, top search, filter chips, featured card, then a list of internships with Apply on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
